name: hulao-gate-upkeep-declined-banish-sacrifices-the-domain
notes: Hulao Gate, Sun's Ascent upkeep: at the start of player 1's recollection phase the banish-a-fire-card offer is declined. The decline used to skip HulaoGateUpkeep, so the 'if you don't, sacrifice Hulao Gate' branch never ran and the Gate stayed forever.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Hulao Gate, Sun's Ascent's optional-choice continuation (HulaoGateUpkeep) was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the prompt (PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods skip the handler and its "if you don't" branch never ran: the domain was never sacrificed. Fix: the queue site passes dontSkipOnPass and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
